label: read-edit-rebaseline
model: claude-opus-5-5[1m] (the opus alias), default effort medium: a top-level user effortLevel does not apply to Opus 5.5
harness_note: Procedure from tests/evals/README.md, with --output-format stream-json --verbose added so tool and text blocks can be counted; every arm ran the same command. Candidate files are copied into each worktree, so lines_added and files_touched exclude them. multi-file-search was scored by reading each final answer.

arms.A: committed prompts at the commit above
arms.B: agents/sisyphus.md and output-styles/omca-default.md rebalanced for Opus 5.5 (size-based delegation, a when-to-speak communication rule), plus hooks.json without the delegation-reminder registrations
arms.C: B with the committed output style (sisyphus and hooks.json only)
arms.D: B with the committed agents/sisyphus.md (output style and hooks.json only)
arms.F: B plus a File tools rule in the output style (read with Read, change with Edit, rather than cat/head/tail/sed -n or a shell heredoc) and hooks.json without the sed-grep-deny registrations

findings: On diff-latitude the minimal solution tracks the Read tool: every trial in every arm that read the file with Read produced a small Edit or Write of 7 lines or fewer. Of the trials that read it through Bash, all but one rewrote the file at 16 to 32 lines; the exception (F-8) made a 2-line in-place shell edit.

B, C, and D reached the minimal solution less often than A (0, 0, and 1 of 8 against 3 of 8). At n=8 this is directional: Fisher's exact p is about 0.2 for B against A, and about 0.04 for the three arms pooled, which is a post-hoc pooling. The one change the three share is the delegation-reminder removal. In the arm A transcripts (observed there, not recorded in these files), the reminder fired after three direct Bash calls and interrupted a Bash rewrite; in three of the four trials where it fired, the model then switched to Read and Edit, which suggests its restraint effect was accidental.

F, which states the Read and Edit preference directly, did better than A on this fixture: median 3 lines against 19, minimal in 5 of 8 against 3 of 8, 8 of 8 passing, at the same cost. The evidence is directional (Fisher's exact p about 0.6 on the minimal count, exact Mann-Whitney p about 0.1 on lines added), and F differs from B by two changes, the File tools rule and the sed-grep-deny removal, so the gain cannot be credited to the rule alone.

The communication rule roughly doubles user-visible text blocks (1.9 to 3.9 on diff-latitude, 2.7 to 5.3 on bug-fix) with no correctness change; bug-fix runs longer (41.7s to 58s) while writing those updates.
No arm delegated on these fixtures, so the delegation rebalance itself is not measured here; it is orchestration-only in this harness.
